title: MapleStory Classic World Release Date
intro: MapleStory Classic World launches October 21, 2026, free to play, after Founder's Access October 6. Both open at 11:00 AM PDT.

blocks.p: [[img:99e27e8c542fc6.png]]
October 21, 2026 · Starts 11:00 AM PDT
Open to everyone
Founder's Package owners
October 6, 2026 · Starts 11:00 AM PDT

**Grand Launch is October 21, 2026. Everyone can play for free.** Founder's Access starts October 6 for Orange Mushroom and Zakum Package owners. Your character and progression carry into Grand Launch. We're almost there, Maplers!

ol:
April 2025 Game announcement Done ▸
Revealed at the Global MapleStory 20th Anniversary event. Nemi confirmed as lead game designer.

June 2025 Private playtest Done ▸
30 players selected from 18,000+ applications.

October 25, 2025 Maple Con LA public demo Done ▸
First public hands-on plus a dev panel with Nemi and CPO Inkwell.

Late 2025 PC Cafe Event (Los Angeles) Done ▸
About 1,900 participants.

Jan 15 - Feb 13, 2026 In-person public testing Done ▸
Cyber City Esports Center, Gardena CA.
Mar 10 - Apr 7, 2026 First COT registration window Done

Apr 16 - Apr 24, 2026 Global Closed Online Test Done ▸
Ran 8 days with about 5,000 players. Started 6:00 PM UTC April 16, ended 12:00 AM UTC April 24.

April 21, 2026 Forgotten Hollow unlocked in COT Done ▸
Mid-COT unlock of the new Lv 39-60 area.

June 6, 2026 IGN Live 2026 showcase Done ▸
MapleStory Classic World featured at IGN Live 2026; first global digital showcase after the COT.

Jul 16 - Jul 29, 2026 2nd COT sign-up window Done ▸
Sign-ups opened July 16 on Nexon's official page and closed July 29. Everyone had to sign up again, including first-test players.

July 31, 2026 Selection emails start Done ▸
Nexon began emailing selected participants on July 31. It did not say how many players it picked, or when the last email goes out.

August 4, 2026 Second Closed Online Test opens Done ▸
Opened at 6:00 PM UTC on August 4, which is 11:00 AM Pacific.

August 8, 2026 Ossyria opens in the test Done ▸
The airship to Ossyria started running at 12:00 AM UTC, which is 5:00 PM Pacific on August 7. Characters level 10 and up could reach Orbis, El Nath, and Dead Mine.

August 11, 2026 Free level 100 for 3rd job testing Done ▸
From 12:00 AM UTC on August 11, which is 5:00 PM Pacific on August 10, the job instructors at the Chief's Residence in El Nath set your character to level 100 so 3rd job skills could be tested. After changing jobs you cannot change again for an hour.

August 13, 2026 Second Closed Online Test ended Done ▸
Closed at 12:00 AM UTC on August 13, which is 5:00 PM Pacific on August 12. Characters, items, and Cash Shop purchases were wiped. The two event rings were not: they land on your account at launch.

August 21, 2026 Launch dates confirmed Done ▸
Nexon's Ossyria Exploration Report confirmed the package sale, Founder's Access, and Grand Launch dates, with no additional closed test planned.

September 2, 2026 Founder's Package sales begin Done ▸
Sales opened on the Nexon webstore and Steam. The three tiers cost $29.99, $59.99, and $79.99, and you can buy, or upgrade a webstore purchase, until 11:59 PM PDT on October 14.

September 29, 2026 Opening time confirmed Done ▸
Nexon's Classic World FAQ set 11:00 AM PDT for both launch dates, and its pre-download post explained how to get ready on the Nexon Launcher and Steam.

October 3, 2026 Founder's Access release notes Done ▸
Nexon set the level cap at 100, listed five bosses, and said it plans to add Forgotten Hollow at a later date.
You are here

Sep 9 - Oct 7, 2026 Frieren Signature Style Collection sale Scheduled ▸
Nexon's Classic store links to the all-worlds article and its rate table. Each random box costs 7,900 NX; ten cost 79,000 NX with no discount. The three Frieren variants are 1.5% each, or 4.5% combined. Our current reading is a 7-day timer on the box and coupons, while opened outfits are permanent unless Nexon says otherwise. Open them fast. Because Classic purchases are not delivered until Grand Launch, the timer should begin after delivery or claim.

October 6, 2026 Founder's Access begins Scheduled ▸
Opens at 11:00 AM PDT. Characters and progression carry into Grand Launch.

October 17, 2026 MapleStory Fest 2026 Scheduled ▸
Nexon plans to show the Classic World roadmap for after launch.

October 21, 2026 Grand Launch Scheduled ▸
Opens at 11:00 AM PDT. Everyone can play from this date, with or without a Founder's Package.

blocks.p: Dates come from Nexon's own posts.

**Official sources:** Ossyria Exploration Report, COT2 sign-up page, MapleStory X announcement, COT1 release notes, COT2 release notes, the Classic World FAQ, the pre-download instructions, and Inkwell's October 2 interview.

**Opening time: 11:00 AM PDT (6:00 PM UTC).** Nexon's September 29 FAQ confirms that hour for both Founder's Access on Tuesday, October 6, and Grand Launch on Wednesday, October 21. That is 2:00 PM EDT and 8:00 PM CEST. In Japan and Australia it is the next morning: 3:00 AM JST in Tokyo, 4:00 AM in Brisbane, 5:00 AM in Sydney and Melbourne.

Founder's Packages went on sale **September 2, 2026**, on Nexon's webstore and on Steam. Sales close at **11:59 PM PDT on October 14**. The **$29.99 Snail Package does not include Founder's Access**. The **$59.99 Orange Mushroom Package** and **$79.99 Zakum Package** include entry on October 6. See all three outfits and Manji's five pieces in our Founder's Package outfits guide.

table: Jr. Balrog Invasion (90 days), Mark of the Founder (Tan), Well-Loved Outfit Set, Glimmer of the Founder
Everything in the Snail Package, plus Mark of the Founder (Brown), Founder's Thief Outfit Set, Glow of the Founder
Everything in the Orange Mushroom Package, plus Mark of the Founder (Black), Manji's Outfit Set, Founder's Chat Ring, Founder's Label Ring, Radiance of the Founder

blocks.p: Where you buy matters. The webstore sells all three tiers and charges the exact difference to upgrade later: $30 from Snail to Orange Mushroom, $50 from Snail to Zakum, and $20 from Orange Mushroom to Zakum. Steam sells only the Zakum Package because Steam does not support those upgrades, and Steam purchases cannot be upgraded at all. The package contents are identical on both platforms, and one purchase covers your account. Prices differ by region: the webstore charges $79.99 USD, 79.99 EUR, or 69.99 GBP for Zakum, while Steam uses your region's Steam pricing. On September 2, Steam's price was 36.99 USD in Türkiye and Argentina, about $48 in Brazil, and about $69 in Canada, but about $92 in Poland, so check both stores before you pay.

**Claiming your package:** items arrive through the in-game mailbox and can be claimed from the start of Founder's Access until **November 30 at 11:59 PM UTC**. A package can be claimed once per account on each platform. You must leave Maple Island before opening the items, and a claimed package must be opened within 30 days.

**Founder's cosmetics are permanent and untradeable once opened.** They give no gameplay or stat benefits, and every job and gender can equip them. Nexon's Founder's Package page adds two details: the outfit-set box itself lasts 30 days and trades within your account, and an opened outfit item moves to your other characters on the same account and in the same world through the Cash Inventory. Jr. Balrog Invasion is a 90-day consumable transformation item.
**Your Founder's Access character and progression carry into Grand Launch.** Starting October 21, everyone can enter and play whether or not they bought a Founder's Package.

**MapleStory Fest 2026** takes place on **Saturday, October 17, 2026**, at **The Hill at Universal City** in Los Angeles. Tickets went on sale August 13 at 2:00 PM Pacific in three tiers: Bronze at $220, Silver at $270, and Gold at $320.
**Nexon plans to show the Classic World roadmap for after launch at the Fest.** Inkwell said so in an October 2 interview. The team is also working on a new boss, with no date yet.

table: Ring Exchange Box (Chat Ring and Label Ring)
Special Hat Exchange Box (pick 1 of 3 hats)

blocks.p: **Attendee Badge character selection locked on August 27 at 12:00 PM Pacific.** The in-game items are handed out after the event to the account tied to the character picked by then, so a ticket with no character selected receives nothing. Changes made in game after the cutoff do not show up on the badge either.
Nexon's release notes for October 6 list the Founder's Access content. The August 21 report also confirms that brand-new content will arrive at Grand Launch, and Nexon has not named it yet.

ul: **Classic maps** on Maple Island and Victoria Island (Lith Harbor, Henesys, Ellinia, Perion, Kerning City, Sleepywood, Florina Beach).
**Up to 3 characters per account.** Deleting one starts a waiting period before it is removed.
**Kerning Party Quest (KPQ)**, named First Time Together, for characters level 21 and up.

**Scrolling** with renamed grade tiers: **Lesser** (100%), **Intermediate** (60%), **Greater** (10%), **Chaos** (10%, bigger fixed bonus, 50% chance to destroy the item on fail). The old numeric names are gone.
**Crafting** for characters level 10 and up, through six professions from Smithing to Arcforge.
**Citizenship** in Henesys and Kerning City for characters level 12 and up. Citizens get discounts on cabs, storage, and some general store items, plus a local specialty shop.
**Beauty Album**, a new feature that saves your hairstyles, faces, and skin colors so you can switch back to them.
**Five bosses**: Mano, Mushmom, Shade, Zombie Mushmom, and Jr. Balrog. King Slime is the boss of the Kerning Party Quest. Shade is not in our monster database yet. See the monster database.

blocks.p: **Ossyria and 3rd job are not initial-launch content.** Nexon's August 21 report says Orbis, El Nath, and 3rd Job Advancement will not be included in Founder's Access or Grand Launch. The team is reworking them and plans to introduce them gradually later. Nexon does not plan to repeat the original MapleStory order exactly, Inkwell said on October 2. Some old content may be adapted, and some will be brand new.

**Forgotten Hollow is closed during Founder's Access.** Nexon's release notes say the path there has not been discovered yet, and the team plans to add it at a later date. Rotten Mushmom lives in the Hollow, and Nexon's list of five bosses leaves it out. See the Forgotten Hollow guide.

ul: **Do not turn COT2 omissions into launch facts.** Nexon has not published a complete launch catalog. Content absent from the test remains unconfirmed unless a current announcement names it.

blocks.p: The level cap is 100. Nexon's Founder's Access release notes set the maximum character level at Lv. 100, with 1st Job Advancement at level 10 and 2nd Job Advancement at level 30. 3rd Job Advancement is not part of the initial launch, so you play levels 30 to 100 on your 2nd job. Our EXP table lists the EXP for every level.

**Founder's First Step** runs from October 6 at 11:00 AM PDT to October 20 at 4:59 PM PDT (11:59 PM UTC). Reach level 10, then talk to Maple Administrator to accept the quest. Your reward follows your total number of check-ins, so a missed day does not reset the count. Each check-in day can be claimed once per account.

table: Leaf Points (5,000) Exchange Coupon, Megaphone x5, Super Megaphone x3, Atmospheric Effect Box x3, Red Potion x30, Blue Potion x30
Leaf Points (1,000) Exchange Coupon, Red Potion x10, Blue Potion x10

blocks.p: The first seven check-ins add up to 11,000 Leaf Points per account. The coupons, megaphones, and effect boxes are untradable and last 7 days. The potions are account-bound and permanent. An Atmospheric Effect Box opens into one random effect: Snowy Snow, Sprinkled Flowers, Soap Bubbles, Sprinkled Presents, or Snowflakes.

**GM events** run in the evening, Pacific time. Nexon lists them in UTC, where each one falls on the next calendar day. For the first three, talk to Paul in Lith Harbor. You cannot join those while you hold a Scroll of Secrets or within 24 hours of your last GM event.

table: Finish the jump quest within 15 minutes for a Scroll of Secrets. Skills like Haste and Teleport are disabled, and consumables have no effect.
Pick the right portals through three stages and reach the last one for a Scroll of Secrets. Skills like Haste and Teleport are disabled, and consumables have no effect.
Two teams hit coconut trees with melee attacks for 5 minutes. The winning team gets a Scroll of Secrets. Harry sells a melee weapon on the event map.
GMs summon Mano, King Slime, Mushmom, Zombie Mushmom, and Jr. Balrog in towns. Death penalties do not apply in a town.

blocks.p: Accounts that completed the '[Event] A Strange and Familiar Wood' and '[Event] Beyond the Unknown' quests during the two closed tests can claim the Classic Beginnings Label/Chat Ring at Grand Launch.
Both tests have official release notes, so the differences are documented: the first test's and the second test's.

blocks.p: The second test's notes do not mention Forgotten Hollow or crafting. They are a highlights post, so that is not the same as either being removed.

blocks.h3: Hair and faces are obtained a different way

ul: **The salon coupons are not in the second test's notes.** The first test sold Henesys and Kerning City coupons in REG (random) and VIP (pick your own) tiers. The second test lists two instead: the **Mystery Coupon**, which rolls a random style, and the **Signature Coupon**, which lets you choose.

**The lists cover 46 hairstyles and 26 faces.** Only nine of them, all faces, were in the first test's coupons: Worrisome Glare, Rebel's Fire, Wisdom Glance, Pucker Up Face, Babyface Pout, Look of Death, Hypnotized Look, Alert Face and Curious Dog.

**62 of those styles were not in the game during the first test at all**, going by the first test's in-game data. The rest of the second test's list is either carried over or was already in the game without being sold.

**The classic styles are not in these lists**: Fantasy, Rockstar, Mo Rawk, Pigtails, Medium Cornrows and the rest of the April rotation. Nexon has not said whether the old salon coupons still exist in game, so that is not the same as those styles being gone.

**Growing Leaf replaces Gathering Leaves.** In the first test you farmed letters from monsters in your level range and traded them in. In the second you take a Pale Maple Leaf, stay online 60 minutes until it ripens, and hand it back. Once a day per account, resetting at 12:00 AM UTC.
**Three new events**: Coconut Harvest (August 5, 8 and 11), Up and Up (August 7 and 10), and Last Day Photo, a group photo with the GMs in Orbis on August 12 at 11:00 PM UTC.
**Physical Fitness Challenge** changed from two 30-minute sessions to one two-hour window. Monster Invasion is unchanged, with the same five bosses.
**The starter gift grew but expires sooner.** It adds a Safety Charm (x3) and a Hired Merchants Box, and its items now last 7 days instead of 10. Cash Shop pets last 3 days instead of 7.

blocks.p: Four original classes plus Beginner. Each 1st-job class advances into one of several 2nd-job branches at level 30, and the second test's release notes name the 3rd-job branches at level 70:
Warrior
Magician
Bowman
Thief

**Pricing**: Grand Launch is free to play on October 21, with a cash shop. Founder's Packages cost $29.99, $59.99, or $79.99, on sale on the Nexon webstore and Steam through October 14. The two higher tiers include Founder's Access on October 6. Nexon says the cash shop will focus mainly on cosmetics and convenience, with no items that directly raise EXP gain or character strength. Its full launch catalog remains unannounced.

**Platforms**: Windows and macOS, through the Nexon Launcher or Steam. English is the official language, and Spanish is in beta. You choose Classic Style or Modern Style key bindings, and Modern Style supports WASD movement. DualSense, DualShock, and Xbox controllers are officially supported over USB or Bluetooth once you turn on controller support in the game options. No mobile or console version has been announced.

ul: **Set up your download.** The Nexon Launcher and Steam need different prep; the download question below has the steps.
**Pick a class** using the class tier list and the 1st-job leveling guides linked below.
**Understand what the damage calculators measure** so you're not guessing about gear tradeoffs. Damage calculator methodology.
**Scout your grind path** with Best Grind Maps for Every Level 1-70.
**Plan your build** in advance. The Character Builder lets you AP-allocate, skill-allocate, and equip-test before launch day.
**Learn the language**. The Glossary explains every acronym and slang term you'll run into on Discord.
**Join the community**. Official Nexon channels + the MeowDB Discord for launch-day strategy and patch notes.

blocks.h3: When does MapleStory Classic World launch?

blocks.p: Founder's Access begins October 6, 2026, at 11:00 AM PDT. Grand Launch follows on October 21 at the same hour, when everyone can play regardless of package purchase.

blocks.h3: What time does MapleStory Classic World launch?

blocks.p: 11:00 AM PDT (6:00 PM UTC) on both October 6 and October 21. Nexon confirmed the hour in its September 29 FAQ. That is 2:00 PM EDT and 8:00 PM CEST, then 3:00 AM JST and 4:00 AM AEST the next morning.

blocks.h3: Do I need the Founder's Package?

blocks.p: Only for Founder's Access. The $59.99 Orange Mushroom Package and $79.99 Zakum Package include entry on October 6. The $29.99 Snail Package does not. Grand Launch on October 21 requires no package.

blocks.h3: When do Founder's Package sales end?

blocks.p: At 11:59 PM PDT on October 14. That deadline covers new purchases on both stores and tier upgrades on the webstore. After you buy, claim the items from the in-game mailbox by November 30 at 11:59 PM UTC. You then have 30 days to open the package.

blocks.h3: Does Founder's Access progress carry over?

blocks.p: Yes. Nexon says your character and progression from Founder's Access carry directly into Grand Launch.

blocks.h3: Are Orbis, El Nath, and 3rd job at launch?

blocks.p: No. Nexon says Orbis, El Nath, and 3rd Job Advancement are not included in Founder's Access or Grand Launch. They are being reworked and will be introduced gradually later.

blocks.h3: Is Forgotten Hollow open at launch?

blocks.p: Not during Founder's Access. Nexon's release notes say the path to Forgotten Hollow has not been discovered yet, and the team plans to add it at a later date. Nexon has not said whether that date is Grand Launch.

blocks.h3: How often will Classic World get updates?

blocks.p: Slower than modern MapleStory, on purpose. Inkwell says the team wants players to have time with each stage before the next one arrives. Several future updates are already prepared. Nexon has not published a schedule. It plans to show its roadmap at MapleStory Fest on October 17.

blocks.h3: How do I get the Mark of Beta?

blocks.p: Through an in-game quest. Nexon plans to start the Mark of Beta event at Grand Launch on October 21, for players who join during the early days of launch. The quest is scheduled to end in November, and Nexon has not published the exact deadline or requirements.

blocks.h3: Will my existing MapleStory characters transfer over?

blocks.p: No. Classic World is a separate world with its own characters. You start fresh at level 1. Only your NX balance carries across from MapleStory. IGNs, Maple Points, and MVP status do not.

blocks.h3: Are Leaf Points a Cash currency?

blocks.p: Yes. Nexon's Classic World FAQ calls Leaf Points an alternative source of Cash currency in Classic World. During Founder's Access, the Founder's First Step check-in gives a Leaf Points (5,000) Exchange Coupon on day 1 and a Leaf Points (1,000) Exchange Coupon on each of days 2 to 7. The first seven check-ins add up to 11,000 Leaf Points per account. Our item database also has coupons for 10,000, 50,000 and 100,000 points.
No. Modern MapleStory keeps running. Classic World is a separate world built around early MapleStory, with its own mechanics and original content.

Yes. Classic World plays through Steam's MapleStory listing, and Steam sells the Zakum Package, the only Founder's Package tier it carries. On Steam the two games come as one bundled build. You also link your Nexon account to your Steam profile. Nexon recommends doing that early from Account Settings on its website; you can also sign in when MapleStory first starts through Steam.

blocks.h3: How do I download MapleStory Classic World?

blocks.p: Through the Nexon Launcher or Steam. On the Nexon Launcher, Classic World is a smaller standalone client, and you do not need MapleStory installed. The client is available from October 6: find MapleStory in your launcher library, switch on the MapleStory Classic World toggle, and download it. The standalone client has no pre-download. Nexon says it cannot be downloaded until launch day and has not announced what time on October 6 the download opens. On Steam, install MapleStory and let it finish updating first; a fully updated install keeps the Classic World patch much smaller. Nexon has not published a spec sheet or install size.

blocks.h3: Can I play MapleStory Classic World on a Mac?

blocks.p: Yes. Nexon's FAQ lists two ways to play on macOS: the Nexon Launcher and Steam's MapleStory listing.

blocks.h3: Where can I play MapleStory Classic World?

blocks.p: Through the Nexon Launcher or Steam, as part of Global MapleStory: both closed-test sign-ups were titled Global MapleStory Classic World Playtest.
Spot something missing or outdated? Tell us in the MeowDB Discord and we'll fix it.
